_comment: Baseline 'last seen' state for each framework source, used by check-framework-updates.yml to detect a possible new publication. Update this file's pageTitle/versionHint by hand only after you've reviewed a flagged change and updated the crosswalk data in src/app/crosswalk/crosswalk-data.ts to match — that's what closes the loop and stops the biannual check from re-flagging the same change.
